verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC compliance platform, so non-documentary identity verification is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence only shows screening customers against sanctions, PEP, watchlist and adverse-media databases. That is a related risk check, not verifying an identity against SSN, national registry or credit-header data, and no such capability is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify identity against authoritative databases without documents — SSN, national registries, or credit-header data — for lower-friction flows where a doc scan is overkill
